sameModeReferenceArchitecture: Apple Silicon and Intel Photoshop under Rosetta, compared to the corresponding Photato slice
scope: The Gray32 comparison covers aligned, full-canvas raster stacks using Normal or Multiply over an opaque base. It includes an ordinary pixel mask, partial layer opacity, and transparent Normal. Cross-mode conversion, transparent Multiply, other blend modes, transformed stacks, and whole-file identity remain open.
